name: Harem of Ankhutep
source:
The story takes place in an ancient world of desert myths. You arrive in the great city of Ankhutep not as a conqueror, but as a man of practical hands and shifting fate. In a land where the Netari, beings shaped from a fusion of mortal and divine flesh, live alongside humanity, you must find your purpose.

[Edited from [url=https://ahanubis.itch.io/harem-of-ankhutep]itch.io[/url]]
